# Star source — Savino (CC0)

- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/star-0
- Original download: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/star.obj
- Author: Savino; published 2011-01-22; retrieved 2026-09-27.
- Source page explicitly lists CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Original OBJ is retained unchanged. The v002 Blender builder imports its OBJ geometry, rounds and widens the outline, rebuilds its caps, changes its proportions, and supplies Carol-specific gold and ivory materials.
- This is a freely licensed geometry starting point, not a claim of final visual quality. Latest Human instruction permits ornament shape departures and prioritizes integrated Carol quality.
- Free3D Crescent Moon v1 was also inspected, but its Personal Use License was unsuitable for this production repository; it was not downloaded or incorporated. The crescent remains original project geometry.
